target_findings.structural_remediation: Every relevant extension is classified by the supplied registry; unknown extensions are UNKNOWN_FORBIDDEN and cannot strengthen a result.
target_findings.residual_limitation: A future implementation must still validate registry content against the declared schema.

target_findings.structural_remediation: Verifier, experiment, and scorer bundles now declare self-contained scopes and separate inventories; explicit run records bind the active scenario, arm, profiles, and experiment-scoped verifier lineage.
target_findings.residual_limitation: The schemas describe supplied content; external standards validation remains a future implementation check.

target_findings.structural_remediation: Every arm source type has permitted record types and schema IDs/versions in a supplied registry.
target_findings.residual_limitation: The initial fixture registry is intentionally small and profile-scoped.

target_findings.structural_remediation: Normalization and classifier inputs are closed, versioned, and truth-independent.
target_findings.residual_limitation: No classifier is trained or executed by this slice.

target_findings.structural_remediation: Condition families have explicit producing roles, consumers, and visibility classes, while run contracts bind experiment-scoped verifier lineage without exposing fixture-private labels.
target_findings.residual_limitation: Observable consequences remain arm-visible only when the role profile says so.

target_findings.structural_remediation: Required/optional/not-applicable binding is selected by an explicit predicate profile and checked against the canonical proposition.
target_findings.residual_limitation: Equivalent descriptors under different IDs remain distinct record identities unless a future profile defines semantic equivalence.

target_findings.structural_remediation: Optional supplied digests now have deterministic SHA-256/canonical-content checks and stable failures.
target_findings.residual_limitation: A missing optional digest remains weaker than a supplied digest; it does not establish provenance by itself.
